tooltip.horizon.wayfarer_shard.0: Found in roadside ruins, camps, villages and dungeons.
tooltip.horizon.wayfarer_shard.1: Warp stones, gem dust, backpack upgrades, salvage.
tooltip.horizon.ancient_core.0: Found in temple and landmark treasure rooms; first kill of a mini-boss.
tooltip.horizon.ancient_core.1: ME controller, socketing sigils, epic ink, Trials.
tooltip.horizon.starforged_heart.0: Landmark vaults (rare) and the first kill of a great boss.
tooltip.horizon.starforged_heart.1: Fusion reactors, 256M storage, enhancement, legendary ink.
tooltip.horizon.tidebound_doubloon.0: Ocean expeditions: wrecks, sunken ruins, pirate ships, monuments.
tooltip.horizon.tidebound_doubloon.1: Trade 6 for a Lunar or Slipstream gem (Expedition Exchange).
tooltip.horizon.cinder_idol.0: Nether expeditions: Incendium castles, fortresses, bastions.
tooltip.horizon.cinder_idol.1: Trade 6 for an Inferno, Blood Lord or Molten Breach gem.
tooltip.horizon.starlit_voidglass.0: End expeditions: cities, castles, wrecks over the void.
tooltip.horizon.starlit_voidglass.1: Trade 6 for an Endersurge or Mageslayer gem.
tooltip.horizon.skyward_plume.0: The Aether: ruined portals, dungeons and their guardians.
tooltip.horizon.skyward_plume.1: Trade 6 for a Solar or Lightning gem.
tooltip.horizon.echoing_fossil.0: The Deep: Ancient Cities, the Otherside, the Undergarden.
tooltip.horizon.echoing_fossil.1: Trade 6 for a Breach or Guardian gem.
tooltip.horizon.honeyed_seal.0: The Bumblezone: solved puzzles, mazes and sanctums.
tooltip.horizon.honeyed_seal.1: Trade 6 for a Verdant Ruin or Splendor gem.
